item.title: What's the Most Awkward Moment of Your Life?
item.description: Tokyo Sims asks strangers to share the most awkward moments they've ever experienced. From embarrassing situations to uncomfortable encounters, people open up about the memories they'd probably rather forget.

item.title: Tokyo Sims Tries to Figure Out Their Relationship Status
item.description: Tokyo Sims meets two people on the streets of Japan and tries to figure out whether they're just friends or romantically involved. A simple question about their relationship status leads to an entertaining and slightly awkward conversation.
